for i in range(1, len(xs)):

The intent is to sum all of `xs`. Let's look at this carefully.

`range(1, len(xs))` produces values from 1 to len(xs)-1 inclusive. So `i` takes values 1, 2, ..., len(xs)-1.

This means the loop iterates from index 1 to len(xs)-1, skipping index 0. So `xs[0]` is never added to `total`.

The bug: The loop starts at index 1 instead of 0, so it skips the first element `xs[0]`. This is an off-by-one error.

The fix: Change `range(1, len(xs))` to `range(0, len(xs))` or equivalently `range(len(xs))`.
